## Objectives

- Defeat 1 Elite Disturbance-touched sawbill ([Sawbill](../monsters/sawbill.md), [Spitting Sawbill](../monsters/spitting_sawbill.md), [Pale Sawbill](../monsters/pale_sawbill.md))
